scopeChangeReason: EXPANSION driven by cross-host review B-70a6-xhr-r1/r2: independent host codex-host-b returned fail with a MAJOR finding (tracked as B-70a6:F-003) that this story adds new durable process-fact semantics (transitionType/reason on PLAN->INIT phase_transition events) without registering them in the process-fact registry or asserting them in the contract verifier. Per the CLAUDE.md dual-layer process-fact contract, a process fact needs prompt guidance PLUS a hardcoded mechanical fallback; without this the audit guarantee can be silently refactored away while the mechanical contract still passes. Adding exactly two files to allowedModify: packages/main/src/core/process-fact-registry.ts (declare the reopen marker + reason semantics) and scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs (mechanically assert REOPEN emits them and ordinary transitions omit them). No other scope change; the four protected files stay protected and the version sync points stay excluded.

acknowledgements.reason: Lifecycle artifact written by the independent lattice-review-story-init reviewer during the INIT gate, not a code change and not scope creep. It has no runtime registry entry so the fail-closed unknown-path rule flags it, but the story contract deliberately declares only material source paths; acknowledging rather than widening allowedModify keeps the contract precise about which CODE may change.
